claim_boundary: This is translation-only air choreography with synthetic contact, center, capture, and insertion events.
The 0.5 mm planar fingerprint ring is not the physical 15 degree conical contact probe.
Passing validates command sequencing, WORLD-axis signs, tracking, return, logging, and KST end only.
